name: Reproduction from a proof bundle
objective: Reproduce a candidate with a bounded proof of concept and keep the bundle that repeats it.
preconditions: A candidate finding exists with evidence and an affected asset
The manifest grants poc.run, which is off by default and supervised unless the operator opts out
steps: Read the candidate record and the artifacts it cites; never the discovering worker's transcript.
State the claim as a condition a fresh run either meets or does not: the status, headers, or body the record describes.
Execute that condition as a bounded read against the same approved asset, with the hostname held to the addresses pinned for this engagement.
Confirm only when every stated condition still holds; reject when one does not; record inconclusive when the run could not decide.
Keep the bundle — plan, argv, environment, exchanges, and manual steps — so the verdict can be replayed without Cyrion.
falsePositives: A transient response can look like a fix or a break; prefer inconclusive over a confident wrong verdict.
A truncated body cannot decide a body condition, and must not be read as a failed reproduction.
